documented_probe: (C-6f5a7578, MuJoCo tuning) The passive double-pendulum reference is intentionally friction/collision-free, so RK4-with-a-larger-aligned-timestep regenerates the reference joint trajectory to within a tiny tolerance at every admissible timestep; the trajectory-preservation constraint is therefore essentially free for any legal dt, and the genuine physics of the discipline to 'preserve the physics trajectory' is exercised but easy. The task earns medium difficulty from the block-manipulation path planner (arbitrary unseen grids, block stacking/movement rules) combined with three coupled deliverables, not from the physics fidelity knob.
notes: Three competencies exercised to produce distinct deliverables: (1) an elevation- and stackable-block-aware path planner that must generalize to unseen hidden grids and always reach its goal; (2) a board-state decoder that reads a rendered game-board PNG into exact occupied intersections plus black/white stone ownership-ship (hidden decoded images included); (3) a MuJoCo model tuned by empirical simulation to run measurably faster while keeping the full sampled qpos trajectory within a strict tolerance. dependent_stages=2 reflects the planner->decode->tune chain and that the planner/decode deliverables are re-run by the grader on fresh hidden inputs. quantitative_correctness=2 because the decoder must exactly recover the occupied-cell set and the physics tolerance is a real numeric bound. standard hidden-case re-run across 3 grids and 2 images gives hidden_case_generalization=3.
